description: This file implements a client API class for interacting with OpenAI's GPT models, including methods for constructing request paths, sending chat requests with streaming support, and querying usage and model lists.

classes.name: ChatGPTApi
classes.description: A class implementing the LLMApi interface for interacting with OpenAI's GPT models, including chat, usage, and model list functionalities.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL based on configuration, including handling Azure and custom URLs.

methods.name: extractMessage
methods.description: Extracts the message content from the API response.

methods.name: chat
methods.description: Sends a chat request to the OpenAI API, supporting streaming responses and handling different content types.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Fetches usage statistics and subscription limits from the API.

methods.name: models
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available models, filtering for GPT models.
